spanish: Y cubrió la nube la tienda de reunión, y la gloria de Jehová llenó el mishkán.

findings.issue: Common noun הַמִּשְׁכָּן (H4908, not a proper name) is left untranslated as mishkán; it must be Spanish.
Spanish la marks the anarthrous construct אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד as definite; the tokens have no article.

notes: Covering, cloud, glory, Jehová, and llenó match the remaining tokens.
